summary: Tests written before build for the Program catalogue (Program__c). Apex ProgramCatalogueTest runs every check as the Recruitment Officer or Minimum Access persona in user mode; TestDataFactory gains buildPrograms/createPrograms. Playwright spec 4-program-catalogue.spec.ts has one test per acceptance criterion plus a delete denial test. All are expected to fail until Program__c, its fields, list view, tab, Recruitment app entry and Persona_Recruitment_Officer permissions are built (plan and ADR 0002).

acceptanceCriteria.evidence: ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerCreateProgramWithAllFields, shouldOfferExactlyTheThreeStudyLevelsAsRestrictedPicklist, shouldOfferExactlyTheFiveFacultiesAsRestrictedPicklist, shouldDefaultNewProgramsToActive, shouldCreate200ProgramsInOneTransaction; Playwright '#4 AC1: Recruitment Officer creates a Program with code, study level, faculty and active'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldMakeProgramCodeAUniqueRequiredExternalId, shouldRejectDuplicateProgramCode, shouldRejectDuplicateProgramCodeInDifferentCase, shouldRequireProgramCode; Playwright '#4 AC2: saving a duplicate Program Code shows a duplicate-value error'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerEditAProgramCreatedBySomeoneElse, shouldGrantProgramAccessThroughPermissionSetNotProfile, shouldRefuseProgramDeleteToRecruitmentOfficer, shouldRefuseProgramCreationToMinimumAccessPersona, shouldRefuseProgramReadToMinimumAccessPersona; Playwright '#4 AC3: Recruitment Officer edits a Program's study level and active flag', '#4 AC3: Recruitment Officer cannot delete a Program (denial, TST-03)'

ProgramCatalogueTest.shouldShipActiveProgramsListViewVisibleToRecruitmentOfficer, shouldShowProgramsTabInRecruitmentApp; Playwright '#4 AC4: Programs tab opens the Active Programs list showing only active programs'

notesForDeveloper: Metadata names the tests rely on: Program__c (Name labelled 'Program Name'), Program_Code__c (Text(20), required, unique, case-insensitive, External Id), Study_Level__c values Undergraduate/Postgraduate_Coursework/Research, Faculty__c values Arts_Humanities/Business/Education/Health/Science_Engineering (both restricted), Active__c default true, list view Active_Programs, tab Program__c in the Recruitment app (label 'Programs').
shouldLetRecruitmentOfficerEditAProgramCreatedBySomeoneElse edits a Program inserted in @TestSetup by the setup user, so it proves the Public Read/Write OWD from plan decision 1.

shouldGrantProgramAccessThroughPermissionSetNotProfile expects no ObjectPermissions for Program__c on the Persona Base profile and Read/Create/Edit without Delete/View All/Modify All on Persona_Recruitment_Officer.
Playwright creates E2E-<runId>-<n> Programs it cannot delete; QA cleanup is the harness's job (plan decision 6b, PIPE-15). The harness files are not changed by this story.
openQuestions: PIPE-15: the harness clean-up of E2E-* Programs in QA (plan decision 6b) is not in this repo yet; it is outside what a story may change (global-setup.ts is integration's copy).
